styles.prompt: Image 1 is a photo of Linda, a real MINI/toy poodle (a small fluffy white Bichon-type poodle with a round cloud-like head, soft curly fluffy coat, long drop ears with curls, dark eyes, black nose): keep her likeness and small fluffy proportions. Image 2 is the previous alebrije set showing the layout and quality wanted. Create the new set for this mini poodle. ALEBRIJE FOLK-ART STYLE (Mexican alebrije, Oaxacan painted-wood-carving look), but ELEGANT and refined: a harmonious, carefully coordinated palette, flat solid color fills, every color region separated by a bold clean black outline so it prints crisply on white and black shirts. The body, ears and curly topknot carry intricate hand-painted alebrije patterns (dots, concentric swirls, stripes, zigzags, tiny flowers, leaf scrolls, scales) arranged neatly in graceful bands that follow the anatomy, not chaotic. Pretty, polished, joyful. Large friendly dark eyes with white catchlights, happy open mouth with pink tongue. No gradients, no shading, no shadows, no frame, no text or letters, flat pure white background. LAYOUT: one canvas with a small FRONT chest emblem (head only, no wings) on the left and the matching full-body sitting BACK print WITH WINGS on the right, both in exactly the same style and palette so they are one coherent set, same layout and proportions as the previous alebrije set shown in image 2. WINGS: a pair of graceful feathered wings, symmetric, gently raised behind the shoulders, layered rows of patterned feathers, elegant and balanced in size with the dog. PALETTE: turquoise, magenta, marigold orange, violet and lime accents with small gold details.
